lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Spatial arrangement of circular high-luminance clusters in an irregular grid pattern across the visible flank; a vertical alignment of three blobs is prominent anterior to the dorsal fin base, with additional clusters distributed at regular intervals along the mid-to-lower flank section.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Subtle vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with the high-luminance blobs on the flank, most visible on the anterior portion to the left of the dorsal fin, forming a series of grid-like nodes.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A prominent horizontal linear ridge extends across the upper third of the flank from the left margin to the anterior base of the dorsal fin, characterized by a sharp vertical gradient from highlight above to shadow below.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: The lateral surface of the first dorsal fin contains approximately 4 to 5 high-luminance blobs, including one near the central region and several clusters located along the posterior margin.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A distinct horizontal linear scar or indentation is visible on the upper posterior section of the dorsal fin surface; an additional horizontal crease is visible at the posterior basal insertion point of the dorsal fin.
other_distinctive_markers: The dorsal fin apex exhibits a blunted, non-acute profile with a small notch-like indentation visible on the upper posterior margin.
